steps.name: focused-gate6-hardening-v2
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=d9d6b40038129e6499d0fd092b628f31f867e20b; git fetch -q origin mvp/environment-controller; git reset --hard $EXPECTED >/dev/null; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; bash -n scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh scripts/quality_gate_push.sh; export CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=1; rm -rf build/host-gate6-hardening-v2 build/idf-gate6-bounded-verify-v2; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-gate6-hardening-v2 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug >/tmp/gate6-hardening-v2-cmake.log; cmake --build build/host-gate6-hardening-v2 --target stage27_telemetry_tests --parallel 1; ./build/host-gate6-hardening-v2/stage27_telemetry_tests; GROWBOX_RF433_LOOPBACK_ENABLED=1 GROWBOX_STAGE28_REAL_OUTPUTS_ENABLED=1 GROWBOX_STAGE28_THERMAL_TEST_SEQUENCE_ENABLED=1 GROWBOX_FIRMWARE_GIT_SHA=$EXPECTED STAGE27C_BUILD_DIR=build/idf-gate6-bounded-verify-v2 bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh build; grep -q '^GROWBOX_STAGE28_REAL_OUTPUTS_ENABLED:STRING=1$' build/idf-gate6-bounded-verify-v2/CMakeCache.txt; grep -q '^GROWBOX_STAGE28_THERMAL_TEST_SEQUENCE_ENABLED:STRING=1$' build/idf-gate6-bounded-verify-v2/CMakeCache.txt; grep -q '^GROWBOX_RF433_LOOPBACK_ENABLED:STRING=1$' build/idf-gate6-bounded-verify-v2/CMakeCache.txt; grep -q 'GROWBOX_STAGE28_REAL_OUTPUTS_ENABLED=1' build/idf-gate6-bounded-verify-v2/compile_commands.json; grep -q 'GROWBOX_STAGE28_THERMAL_TEST_SEQUENCE_ENABLED=1' build/idf-gate6-bounded-verify-v2/compile_commands.json; git diff --check; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; printf 'GATE6_HARDENING_V2_FOCUSED_PASS commit=%s bounded_build=1 rf_tx=0\n' "$EXPECTED"

verify_steps.name: full-quality-gate-v2
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=d9d6b40038129e6499d0fd092b628f31f867e20b; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; export CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=1; bash scripts/quality_gate_push.sh; git diff --check; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; printf 'GATE6_HARDENING_V2_VERIFY_COMPLETE commit=%s real_outputs=0 rf_tx=0\n' "$EXPECTED"
